profile.title: Time-resolved Brownian trajectories for the pulmonary channel case

validity.population: software refinement verification against the M4.8 pulmonary-bound synthetic tracer case
validity.physiological_state: healthy-adult resting supine capillary context; synthetic local molecular signal
validity.description: Independent fixed-step Brownian trajectories at 8 and 32 steps verify receiver occupancy and mean squared displacement against the same unbounded free-diffusion reference. Four refined trajectories are retained under an explicit 132-point bound.

limitations: The executable pulmonary reference remains unbounded; reflecting axis-aligned box walls are a software capability, not an anatomical pulmonary geometry.

Free diffusion has an exact Gaussian transition at every step, so refinement agreement verifies implementation and path statistics rather than measuring a discretization bias in the endpoint distribution.
Particles are independent and non-interacting; flow, binding, bimolecular reactions, crowding, heterogeneous diffusivity, and receiver kinetics are absent.
Only a bounded subset of trajectories is retained; aggregate receiver and displacement statistics still include every simulated particle.
The comparison is software verification with synthetic molecular parameters, not physiological or clinical validation.
